description: This source file defines extension methods for the IGrainContext interface in the Orleans framework, specifically for managing resource factory registries associated with grains in distributed transaction contexts.

classes.name: ResourceFactoryRegistry`1
classes.description: A dictionary subclass mapping resource names to factory functions, used to manage resource factories within grain contexts.

methods.name: RegisterResourceFactory
methods.description: Registers a resource factory with a given name within the grain context.

methods.name: GetResourceFactoryRegistry
methods.description: Retrieves the resource factory registry for a specific resource type; optionally creates it if it does not exist.
